events.label: Наука
entries: 1683 – Antonie van Leeuwenhoek writes a letter to the Royal Society describing "animalcules", later known as protozoa.
1976 – The Space Shuttle Enterprise is unveiled by NASA.

events.label: Образование
entries: 1630 – The city of Boston, Massachusetts, is founded in North America.
1776 – The Presidio of San Francisco is founded in New Spain.
1924 – The Border Protection Corps is established in the Second Polish Republic for the defence of the eastern border against armed Soviet raids and local bandits.
1950 – The People's Liberation Army Air Force Airborne Corps (Then known as the PLAAF 1st Ground Forces Brigade) is founded.
1980 – After weeks of strikes at the Lenin Shipyard in Gdańsk, Poland, the nationwide independent trade union Solidarity is established.

events.label: Литература
entries: 1543 – The first Finnish-language book, the Abckiria by Mikael Agricola, is published in Stockholm.
